full_text_en:
All my life I was terrified someone watching me through laptop camera, even the FBI director taped his...

Claude Code dug through my laptop's hidden logs and found suspicious moments I can't explain 

check yours and shut down your camera without a sticker:

what it found:

- an unknown app turning on my camera at night, while I sleep
- Windows quietly remembers apps (could be spy) that turned on your camera, even after you delete them

why you should do it today:

- a $40 spy tool bought in 100+ countries infected 500,000+ computers and could switch on their webcams remotely (US Departament of Justice)
- a US school district secretly took 30,000+ webcam photos of students on school laptops, some inside their homes (Lower Merion)
- even FBI director put tape over his laptop camera (James Comey)

Windows:

1. install repo below and type /camera-guard in Claude Code, it reads the hidden log of every app that ever turned on your camera and mic

2. delete AnyDesk, TeamViewer ot any remote app you don't use

3. Windows has a hidden "Camera on/off pop-up, off by default, ask Claude to turn it on and you see every time the camera starts

4. really shut camera off, Settings switch isn't enough:

• BIOS (strongest ): hold shift, click Restart - Troubleshoot → Advancedf options → UEFI Firmware Settings , set Camera to Disabled and add a BIOS password.

Windows can't see the camera at all. Need it for a call? - Turn it back on there. Not every laptop has it, Claude checks your model

• camera switch or key: some laptops have a slider on the side or an F-key with a crossed-out camera. Slide it off when you're not using it

• Device Manager → Cameras → Desible device: one click to undo (but any app with admin rights can undo it too)

5. run Microsoft Defender Offline, the deep scan built into Windows (Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → scan options): it restarts your PC and hunts hard-to-catch spyware before Windows starts

Mac: 

1. install repo below and type /camera-guard, it checks which apps can use your camera and mic and what starts with your Mac

2. System Settings → General → Sharing: turn off Screen Sharing, Remote Login and Remote Management, these let someone see and control your Mac from another computer

3. Screen Time → Content & Privacy → App & Feature Restrictions → Camera: off + a Screen time passcode - Apple's own camera off swith

4. install OverSight, free Mac app: it pops up an alert second any app turns on your camera or mic, so you know the moment anyhting starts filming or listening

Please do this today. Then read article below on how to solve such problems on another tech:

title_zh:
几周前，我们推出了 Surface Laptop Ultra，包括新的磁性 USB-C 电源连接器。

我们在 Surface 上花费大量时间的事情之一就是获得恰到好处的交互感觉。对于此连接器，重点在于磁铁如何将其引导到位、声音和 LED
full_text_en:
A couple weeks ago, we introduced Surface Laptop Ultra, including our new magnetic USB-C power connector. 

One of the things we spend a lot of time on in Surface is getting the feel of an interaction just right. With this connector, it's about how the magnets guide it into place, the sound and LED that let you know it's connected, and how easily it releases. 

The team built hundreds of prototypes, experimenting with magnet sizes, positions, forces, and cable alignment. 

One of my favorite details: moving the magnets just 0.7mm changed the experience from needing a final push to smoothly finding its way into place. 

Once we found the right feel, the next challenge was making it repeatable. The team selected a prototype that captured the experience we wanted, then worked through simulations and multiple manufacturing iterations to reproduce that feel in production. 

And it had to hold up. Thousands of connection cycles, off-axis pulls, and tests for the kinds of forces a cable might experience when someone trips over it. 

The cable has another useful detail: flip it around, and you can charge other USB-C devices, like your phone. 

A lot of work across industrial design, mechanical engineering, reliability, and manufacturing to make one small interaction feel right.
full_text_zh:
几周前，我们推出了 Surface Laptop Ultra，包括新的磁性 USB-C 电源连接器。

我们在 Surface 上花费大量时间的事情之一就是获得恰到好处的交互感觉。对于此连接器，重点在于磁铁如何将其引导到位、声音和 LED 灯让您知道其已连接以及释放的容易程度。

该团队构建了数百个原型，对磁铁尺寸、位置、力和电缆对齐进行了实验。

我最喜欢的细节之一：将磁铁仅移动 0.7 毫米，改变了体验，从需要最后推动到顺利找到到位。

一旦我们找到了正确的感觉，下一个挑战就是使其可重复。该团队选择了一个能够捕捉我们想要的体验的原型，然后通过模拟和多次制造迭代来在生产中重现这种感觉。

而且它必须坚持下去。数千次连接循环、离轴拉力以及当有人被绊倒时电缆可能受到的各种力的测试。

该电缆还有另一个有用的细节：将其翻转过来，您就可以为其他 USB-C 设备（例如手机）充电。

在工业设计、机械工程、可靠性和制造方面进行了大量的工作，以确保一次小小的互动感觉良好。

title:
Google Has an IBM Problem: AI Is Cannibalizing the Core

Alphabet’s recent stock drop is not just about one earnings rep
title_zh:
谷歌面临 IBM 问题：人工智能正在蚕食核心

Alphabet 最近的股价下跌不仅仅是因为一份财报。这是一个更大的战略问题：谷歌可能正在进入与 IBM 在云计算兴起期间面临的同样的转型。

路透社报道了市场反应：https://t.co/
full_text_en:
Google Has an IBM Problem: AI Is Cannibalizing the Core

Alphabet’s recent stock drop is not just about one earnings report. It is about a much bigger strategic problem: Google may be entering the same kind of transition IBM faced during the rise of cloud computing.

Reuters covered the market reaction here: https://t.co/SgDDdQ0DNA

The prevailing logic from investors is pretty straightforward. The more Google pushes AI answers, AI summaries, and AI-native search experiences, the less users need traditional Google search. And the less users need traditional search, the harder it becomes to protect the advertising model that made Google one of the most profitable companies in history.

That is the uncomfortable truth about disruption when you are the incumbent: the right move strategically can still damage the business financially in the short term.

IBM had to deal with this years ago. Cloud computing was, in many ways, a direct threat to the traditional hardware and services model. If customers could rent infrastructure on demand over the open internet, they had less reason to buy and manage large amounts of hardware themselves. IBM had to get into cloud, but doing so meant participating in the erosion of parts of its own legacy business.

Google is now facing a similar issue. AI is not optional. If Google does not lead in AI, others will. But if Google does lead in AI, it risks weakening the search-and-ads engine that funds much of the company.

There is no easy path here.

The strategic opportunity for Google is to stop thinking about AI as a feature bolted onto search and start thinking about it as a new monetization platform. That means new ad models, new enterprise AI services, deeper cloud integration, and AI experiences where commercial intent can still be captured without degrading user trust.

The danger is that Google tries to preserve the old model too long while the market moves to a new one.

IBM had to learn that lesson during the cloud transition. Google is learning it now during the AI transition.
full_text_zh:
谷歌面临 IBM 问题：人工智能正在蚕食核心

Alphabet 最近的股价下跌不仅仅是因为一份财报。这是一个更大的战略问题：谷歌可能正在进入与 IBM 在云计算兴起期间面临的同样的转型。

路透社报道了市场反应：

投资者普遍的逻辑非常简单。谷歌越多地推出人工智能答案、人工智能摘要和人工智能原生搜索体验，用户对传统谷歌搜索的需求就越少。用户对传统搜索的需求越少，保护使谷歌成为历史上最赚钱的公司之一的广告模式就越困难。

当你担任现任者时，这就是关于颠覆的令人不安的事实：正确的战略举措仍然可能在短期内损害企业的财务利益。

IBM 几年前就不得不处理这个问题。从很多方面来说，云计算对传统硬件和服务模式构成了直接威胁。如果客户可以通过开放互联网按需租用基础设施，他们就没有理由自己购买和管理大量硬件。 IBM 必须进军云计算，但这样做意味着参与侵蚀其部分传统业务。

谷歌现在也面临着类似的问题。人工智能不是可选的。如果谷歌不在人工智能领域处于领先地位，其他人也会。但如果谷歌确实在人工智能领域处于领先地位，它就有可能削弱为该公司提供大部分资金的搜索和广告引擎。

这里没有平坦的道路。

谷歌的战略机遇是停止将人工智能视为附加在搜索上的功能，并开始将其视为新的货币化平台。这意味着新的广告模式、新的企业人工智能服务、更深入的云集成以及仍然可以捕获商业意图而不降低用户信任的人工智能体验。

危险在于，当市场转向新模式时，谷歌试图将旧模式保留得太久。

IBM 必须在云转型过程中吸取教训。谷歌现在正在人工智能转型过程中学习这一点。

投资者普遍的逻辑非常简单。谷歌越多地推出人工智能答案、人工智能摘要和人工智能原生搜索体验，用户对传统谷歌搜索的需求就越少。用户对传统搜索的需求越少，保护使谷歌成为历史上最赚钱的公司之一的广告模式就越困难。

当你担任现任者时，这就是关于颠覆的令人不安的事实：正确的战略举措仍然可能在短期内损害企业的财务利益。

IBM 几年前就不得不处理这个问题。从很多方面来说，云计算对传统硬件和服务模式构成了直接威胁。如果客户可以通过开放互联网按需租用基础设施，他们就没有理由自己购买和管理大量硬件。 IBM 必须进军云计算，但这样做意味着参与侵蚀其部分传统业务。

谷歌现在也面临着类似的问题。人工智能不是可选的。如果谷歌不在人工智能领域处于领先地位，其他人也会。但如果谷歌确实在人工智能领域处于领先地位，它就有可能削弱为该公司提供大部分资金的搜索和广告引擎。

这里没有平坦的路。

谷歌的战略机遇是停止将人工智能视为附加在搜索上的功能，并开始将其视为新的货币化平台。这意味着新的广告模式、新的企业人工智能服务、更深入的云集成以及仍然可以捕获商业意图而不降低用户信任的人工智能体验。

危险在于，当市场转向新模式时，谷歌试图将旧模式保留得太久。

IBM 必须在云转型过程中吸取教训。谷歌现在正在人工智能转型过程中学习这一点。

title: Holy Shit: WIRED reports an Accenture contractor gave a Claude Code agent admin access to NIPRNet, an unclassified Penta
title_zh: 天哪：《连线》报道称，埃森哲承包商向 Claude Code 代理授予了 NIPRNet（一个非机密五角大楼网络）的管理员访问权限，以编写和部署代码。它运行了两个月，显然将登录凭据、密码和网络地图发送到 NIST 标记为高风险的第三方网站。
full_text_en:
Holy Shit: WIRED reports an Accenture contractor gave a Claude Code agent admin access to NIPRNet, an unclassified Pentagon network, to write and deploy code. It ran for two months, apparently sending login credentials, passwords and a network map to a third-party site NIST had flagged as high risk.

Contractors must report breaches within 72 hours, yet sources say Accenture initially didn't report it at all. A source calls it "100 percent a national security threat."
full_text_zh:
天哪：《连线》报道称，埃森哲承包商向 Claude Code 代理授予了 NIPRNet（一个非机密五角大楼网络）的管理员访问权限，以编写和部署代码。它运行了两个月，显然将登录凭据、密码和网络地图发送到 NIST 标记为高风险的第三方网站。

承包商必须在 72 小时内报告违规行为，但消息人士称埃森哲最初根本没有报告此事。消息人士称其为“100%的国家安全威胁”。

title: Today, I delivered a lecture to members of Senior Executive Course (SEC) 47 at the National Institute for Policy and Str
title_zh:
今天，我在乔斯库鲁国家政策与战略研究所 (NIPSS) 为高级行政人员课程 (SEC) 47 的成员发表了演讲，主题为：“通过积极立法提高治理的效率和有效性：以第十届参议院为例”。

在旨在反思立法对公共治理的核心地位的演讲中，我将最近约
full_text_en:
Today, I delivered a lecture to members of Senior Executive Course (SEC) 47 at the National Institute for Policy and Strategic Studies (NIPSS), Kuru, Jos, on the theme: "Improving the Efficiency and Effectiveness of Governance Through Pro-Active Lawmaking: The 10th Senate as a Case Study".

At the lecture which aimed at reflecting on the centrality of lawmaking to public governance, I described the recent approval of the State Police Alteration Bill, 2026, by about thirty state houses of assembly as a historic milestone in our collective re-engineering of Nigeria's security architecture. 

I told the course participants and the very distinguished audience that the creation of state police had moved from mere rhetoric to reality, with an assurance that the reform is not aimed at weakening the center but strengthening the federation and its policing system. 

I noted that under the leadership of the President of the Senate, Senator Godswill Obot Akpabio GCON, we have deliberately pursued strategic, people-centered legislations which have positive impacts on the Nigerian masses.

Among others, I listed these key legislations to include the Students Loans (Access to Higher Education) Act, 2024, the Minimum Wage (Amendment) Act, 2024, the four Tax Reform Acts, 2025 and the National Social Investment Programme Act.

On the NIPPS-National Assembly partnership, I reminded the nation's highest training institute that it has a special role to play at this crucial period in the life of our nation. I also acknowledged its demonstration of capacity to bring together experienced Nigerians from the public sector, military, private sector, academia and other walks of life towards charting a course the greatness of Nigeria and by extension, the African continent.

I want to express my sincere gratitude to the management of NIPSS under the leadership of its Director-General, Prof. Ayo Omotayo, for granting me this platform, and to my colleagues at the Senate and other well-meaning Nigerians for gracing today's event. Thank you all.
full_text_zh:
今天，我在乔斯库鲁国家政策与战略研究所 (NIPSS) 为高级行政人员课程 (SEC) 47 的成员发表了演讲，主题为：“通过积极立法提高治理的效率和有效性：以第十届参议院为例”。

在旨在反思立法对公共治理的核心地位的演讲中，我将最近约 30 个州议会批准的《2026 年州警察变更法案》描述为我们集体重新设计尼日利亚安全架构的历史性里程碑。

我告诉课程参与者和非常杰出的观众，建立州警察已经从单纯的言辞转变为现实，并保证改革的目的不是削弱中央，而是加强联邦及其治安系统。

我指出，在参议院议长戈德斯威尔·奥博特·阿克帕比奥·GCON参议员的领导下，我们有意识地推行了战略性的、以人为本的立法，对尼日利亚群众产生了积极影响。

其中，我列出的这些关键立法包括《2024 年学生贷款（接受高等教育）法》、《2024 年最低工资（修正案）法》、《2025 年四项税收改革法》和《国家社会投资计划法》。

关于NIPPS与国民议会的伙伴关系，我提醒国家最高培训机构，它在我们国家生命的这个关键时期可以发挥特殊的作用。我还承认它表现出了将来自公共部门、军队、私营部门、学术界和其他各行各业的经验丰富的尼日利亚人聚集在一起的能力，以制定尼日利亚乃至非洲大陆的伟大之路。

我要衷心感谢在总干事阿约·奥莫塔约教授领导下的 NIPSS 管理层为我提供这个平台，并感谢参议院的同事和其他好心的尼日利亚人为今天的活动增光添彩。谢谢大家。

我要衷心感谢在总干事阿约·奥莫塔约教授领导下的 NIPSS 管理层为我提供这个平台，并感谢参议院的同事和其他好心的尼日利亚人为今天的活动增光添彩。谢谢大家。

full_text_en:
THIS IS F*CKING GOLD, MAN

BORIS CHERNY BUILT CLAUDE CODE AND HIS TEAM SHIPPED A F*CKING FLAG THAT FIXES YOUR OPUS BILL

Opus 5.5 stays on call as the architect, Haiku 5.5 swarms the repo, and Sonnet 5.5 does the building

put the architect on call with one flag

claude --model sonnet --advisor opus

Sonnet 5.5 runs the main session on high effort, writing the diffs and running the tests
Haiku 5.5 subagents swarm the repo in parallel: file discovery, call sites, API docs, test runs
Opus 5.5 waits in the background as the advisor and only gets pulled in at three moments:

→ before a plan locks: is the plan missing an auth rule or a schema contract?
→ when a test breaks twice: are we fixing the root cause or digging a rabbit hole?
→ before calling it done: did the diff sneak in a regression nobody asked for?

every other turn, Opus says nothing and reads nothing new

Opus reviews. Sonnet builds. Haiku swarms.

JEV engineering is the same pattern one layer down: the forks that need no thinker (which file, which tool, retry or stop) get settled in code, and the big models only wake up when the path actually splits

Plan on high. Delegate on medium. Keep Opus on call.

paste this into Claude Code ↓

"Set up my workspace for an advisor tree:
1. Run the main session on Sonnet 5.5 with Opus 5.5 as advisor.
2. Create three Haiku 5.5 subagents in .claude/agents: explorer (maps the repo), researcher (pulls docs and specs), test-runner (runs the suite, reports only failures).
3. Add one rule to CLAUDE.md: ask the advisor before a plan locks, after the same test fails twice, and before calling a task done.
4. Route fast deterministic forks (tool choice, path selection, retries) through JEV.
Show me every change as a diff first. No edits until I say go."

↳ https://t.co/vOifNVjYxB

save it, your Opus limit will thank you

这是他妈的黄金，伙计

BORIS CHERNY 构建了 Claude Code，他的团队发布了一面可以解决您的 OPUS 账单的该死的旗帜

Sonnet 5.5 非常努力地运行主会话，编写差异并运行测试
Haiku 5.5 子代理并行聚集存储库：文件发现、调用站点、API 文档、测试运行
Opus 5.5 作为顾问在后台等待，仅在三个时刻被拉入：

→ 在计划锁定之前：该计划是否缺少身份验证规则或模式契约？
→ 当一个测试失败两次时：我们是在解决根本原因还是在挖兔子洞？
→ 在完成之前：差异是否潜入了无人要求的回归？

每隔一回合，Opus 就什么也不说，也没有读到任何新内容

作品评论。十四行诗构建。俳句蜂拥而至。

JEV工程在下一层是相同的模式：不需要思考者的分叉（哪个文件，哪个工具，重试或停止）在代码中解决，而大模型仅在路径实际分裂时醒来

计划高高在上。媒介上的代表。让 Opus 随时待命。

“为顾问树设置我的工作区：
1. 在 Sonnet 5.5 上运行主会话，Opus 5.5 作为顾问。
2. 在 .claude/agents 中创建三个 Haiku 5.5 子代理：explorer（映射存储库）、researcher（拉取文档和规范）、test-runner（运行套件，仅报告故障）。
3. 在 CLAUDE.md 中添加一条规则：在计划锁定之前、同一测试失败两次之后以及调用任务完成之前询问顾问。
4. 通过 JEV 路由快速确定性分叉（工具选择、路径选择、重试）。
首先将每个更改显示为差异。在我说走之前不能进行任何编辑。”

title: We’ve trained Claude to flag potential misuse in conversations, a technique we call self-assessment. Right after it resp
title_zh:
我们训练克劳德标记对话中潜在的滥用行为，我们称之为自我评估的技术。在它做出回应后，克劳德立即对对话进行了初步的安全评估。

自从我们从 6 月份开始使用自我评估以来，我们的其他保护措施并没有旨在发现滥用行为。

因为克劳德已经看过对话了，所
full_text_en:
We’ve trained Claude to flag potential misuse in conversations, a technique we call self-assessment. Right after it responds, Claude gives a preliminary safety assessment of the conversation. 

Since we began using self-assessment in June, it has surfaced misuse that our other safeguards weren’t designed to catch. 

Because Claude has already read the conversation, self-assessment is very efficient. And unlike classifiers, which target a discrete set of harms, it draws on Claude’s own judgment, so it gets more accurate as our models improve.

Read more on our new Safeguards blog:

I just reverse-engineered CCleaner / CleanMyMac with Opus 5.5 for Mac & Windows PC

this is insane...

one tap → 14.6 GB of junk gone. fully open-source and free.

→ https://t.co/xdi6E5WvBM

here’s the build step by step:

• step 1 → open Claude Code on Opus 5.5 in an empty folder, paste the prompt below + a few CleanMyMac screenshots

• step 2 → Opus didn’t start coding. it drew 9 UI concepts on a canvas first.

i picked one, it rebuilt the fonts, icons and glass buttons until it looked like Apple made it

• step 3 → i sent it a random video of smoky gradients.

Opus turned it into a live WebGL shader: “cosmic wind” rising behind the scan result

• step 4 → stack: one Electron + React codebase that runs on macOS and Windows

• step 5 → Opus split the build across 8 parallel agents.

one wrote the junk scanner, one the disk map, one the AI assistant, one the tips & feedback screens, one the installers

• step 6 → a separate safety agent attacked every line that deletes something.

it caught a Windows short-name trick (DOCUME~1) that could’ve sent my whole Documents folder to the Recycle Bin. and an icon loader that could leak my Windows password hash to a remote machine

• step 7 → the disk map is a physics toy: drag a folder bubble, throw it, watch it bump the others

• step 8 → built-in AI: plug in Claude or ChatGPT and ask “what can i safely delete?”

it only sees file names and sizes, never contents

• step 9 → GitHub Actions builds the .dmg and the .exe on every release.

the Mac build runs on Apple hardware in the cloud, not on my PC

• step 10 → first real test: the startup-apps toggle said “Windows did not allow the change”

Opus found PowerShell was losing the exit code after the admin prompt, made the app check the registry instead. next build: works

one afternoon. zero lines written by me. 14.6 GB freed on the first click. that’s it...

Find full prompt below ↓

Then, read how to rebuild any app from scratch with Opus 5.5 in the article below.

一位编写垃圾扫描程序，一位编写磁盘映射，一位编写人工智能助手，一位编写提示和反馈屏幕，一位编写安装程序

它发现了 Windows 短名称技巧 (DOCUME~1)，该技巧可能会将我的整个文档文件夹发送到回收站。以及一个可能会将我的 Windows 密码哈希泄露到远程计算机的图标加载器

它只能看到文件名和大小，不能看到内容

Mac 版本在云端的 Apple 硬件上运行，而不是在我的 PC 上运行

Introducing *Switch*: a *harness framework* for *decision models* like Jev

I looked for this the other day and was surp
title_zh:
隆重推出 *Switch*：针对 Jev 等“决策模型”的“利用框架”

前几天我找过这个，很惊讶没有找到类似的东西

显然，您不能在像 @pidotdev 这样的编码代理工具中使用像 LLM 这样的决策模型，因为 Jev 无法生成工具调用
full_text_en:
Introducing *Switch*: a *harness framework* for *decision models* like Jev

I looked for this the other day and was surprised to not find anything like it

You obviously cannot use a decision model like an LLM in a coding agent harness like @pidotdev, because Jev cannot generate tool calls

But what if there was a framework that "generated the tool calls" for it programmatically, and Jev only had to pick out of that finite set of choices

That is what switch does. You pick a "domain" to implement the decision model in, and it provides a core API to define your state, and the functions that will derive decision model questions out of that state. Chess is a domain, as well as being a rubric judge for evals

It basically standardizes what I imagine a lot of people are already vibe-coding, to an abstract interface: calling a decision-model API through multiple steps, i.e. an agent loop over finite choices

Because of the finiteness of the output of a decision model, you cannot have a general pure decision model harness. Instead, you need to implement specific ones that generate the choices programmatically (or have an LLM generate the choices, but I find the former more interesting) 

A primary use case I have for this is use as a judge in an eval. For example, At the end of a task run that involves a bunch of documents, most people currently follow this approach: extract text out of PDF/docx/md files, and dump them right into the context

But what if the visual formatting of the output is a judging criterion? Then you have to dump an image of every page in the input state. But what if you have 200 pages, and your question does not need looking at all of them? What if Jev could navigate through the haystack and find the info it needs?

I have noticed that Jev is not so good at chess nor being a Decision-Model-as-a-Judge. It sucks at chess, and it does not perform well enough to replace GPT 6.1 Sol as a judge in the domain I am working for

But switch is not only for Jev! It is for any decision model including the ones supported by the pi-ai package

So once you can generate enough data with a better model, you should be able to pick an open source one and fine-tune it on your use case to perform better! And the model should be trained in a harness like switch's to be especially performant and cost-efficient

I wanted to get this out because I find the idea very exciting, at least for benchmarking. Jev is currently not there, but decision models obviously will be there at some point, and we can take them there! There are also a lot of potential gains from picking a specific domain, and creating a looping agent that does a job for 100x cheaper!

Let me know if you have any ideas, I am quite keen to try this on new domains!

Repo: https://t.co/PRvdOGt32w
full_text_zh:
隆重推出 *Switch*：针对 Jev 等“决策模型”的“利用框架”

前几天我找过这个，很惊讶没有找到类似的东西

显然，您不能在像 @pidotdev 这样的编码代理工具中使用像 LLM 这样的决策模型，因为 Jev 无法生成工具调用

但是，如果有一个框架能够以编程方式“生成工具调用”，而 Jev 只需要从有限的一组选择中进行选择呢？

这就是 switch 的作用。您选择一个“域”来实现决策模型，它提供了一个核心 API 来定义您的状态，以及从该状态导出决策模型问题的函数。国际象棋是一个领域，也是评估的评判者

它基本上将我想象的很多人已经在振动编码的东西标准化为一个抽象接口：通过多个步骤调用决策模型 API，即有限选择上的代理循环

由于决策模型输出的有限性，您无法拥有通用的纯决策模型工具。相反，您需要实现以编程方式生成选择的特定选项（或者让 LLM 生成选择，但我发现前者更有趣）

我对此的一个主要用例是在评估中用作法官。例如，在涉及一堆文档的任务运行结束时，大多数人目前都遵循这种方法：从 PDF/docx/md 文件中提取文本，并将它们直接转储到上下文中

但如果输出的视觉格式是一个判断标准呢？然后你必须转储输入状态下每个页面的图像。但是，如果您有 200 页，并且您的问题不需要查看所有页面，该怎么办？如果 Jev 能够在大海捞针中导航并找到所需的信息会怎么样？

我注意到杰夫不太擅长国际象棋，也不太擅长作为法官的决策模型。它在国际象棋方面很糟糕，并且它的表现不足以取代 GPT 6.1 Sol 作为我工作领域的法官

但 switch 不仅仅适合 Jev！它适用于任何决策模型，包括 pi-ai 包支持的决策模型

因此，一旦您可以使用更好的模型生成足够的数据，您应该能够选择一个开源模型并根据您的用例对其进行微调以提高性能！该模型应该在像开关这样的线束中进行训练，以获得特别高性能和成本效益

我想把这个说出来，因为我发现这个想法非常令人兴奋，至少对于基准测试来说是这样。 Jev 目前不在那里，但决策模型显然会在某个时候出现，我们可以将它们带到那里！选择一个特定的域并创建一个以 100 倍便宜的价格完成工作的循环代理也可以获得很多潜在的收益！

如果您有任何想法，请告诉我，我非常热衷于在新领域尝试这一点！

title: An AI agent with permission to buy and sell isn’t just a wallet. It’s a standing instruction to move your money, and tha
title_zh:
拥有买卖权限的人工智能代理不仅仅是一个钱包。这是转移资金的长期指令，这使得它成为比任何静态地址都要大得多的目标。

如果代理的流量被暴露，它携带的每个密钥、凭证和权限都会成为攻击面的一部分，所有这些都通过一个从未被构建来隐藏它的网络传输。
full_text_en:
An AI agent with permission to buy and sell isn’t just a wallet. It’s a standing instruction to move your money, and that makes it a far bigger target than any static address.

If the agent’s traffic is exposed, every key, credential and permission it carries becomes part of the attack surface, all of it traveling across a network that was never built to hide it.

Anyone secures that layer, so the agent can act on your behalf without broadcasting where it is or what it’s connected to.
full_text_zh:
拥有买卖权限的人工智能代理不仅仅是一个钱包。这是转移资金的长期指令，这使得它成为比任何静态地址都要大得多的目标。

如果代理的流量被暴露，它携带的每个密钥、凭证和权限都会成为攻击面的一部分，所有这些都通过一个从未被构建来隐藏它的网络传输。

任何人都可以保护该层，因此代理可以代表您行事，而无需广播它的位置或连接的内容。
